info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Rewards Management API
info.description: The Rewards Management API allows businesses to update and adjust specific reward details efficiently. By targeting individual rewards identified by their unique rewardId, this API facilitates modifications to existing incentives in the rewards program. It is particularly useful for customer service teams or application administrators who need to correct or enhance reward offerings based on user feedback or changing business strategies. This service ensures that rewards remain relevant and valuable to customers, fostering ongoing engagement and satisfaction.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the reward identified by the given resource ID. Use this operation to modify reward attributes as needed.

requestBody.description: This PATCH request updates specific fields of the rewards service identified by the unique identifier RES-100045. Ensure all necessary fields are included, and only the fields that need to be changed are sent in the request body.
